title: VirtualParticipant
description: A virtual (convergence) market participant. Supply offers map to the operating cost's incremental offer curves; demand bids map to decremental offer curves. Settles either at a settlement point or at associated trading hubs — the two are mutually exclusive; hub membership is carried as TradingHubAssociation rows rather than a list on this record, matching the trading hub's own membership convention.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the component. Components of the same type (e.g., `PowerLoad`) must have unique names, but components of different types (e.g., `PowerLoad` and `ACBus`) can have the same name.

available.description: Indicator of whether the participant is available for market clearing (`true`) or not (`false`).

settlement_point_id.description: ID of the location this participant settles at — a bus, area, or load zone. `null` when the participant settles at trading hubs instead.

max_supply.description: Maximum envelope for the incremental (supply) side. Units: MW.

max_demand.description: Maximum envelope for the decremental (demand) side. Units: MW.

operation_cost.description: Bid curves as an offer-curve operating cost.
